opening.argument: The offer is built around acquiring rewards through low-barrier app participation: it advertises daily Paytm cash without investment, while the app presents tasks with RECEIVE buttons and a withdrawal screen showing a rupee balance. The flow also includes a bank-account form requesting Bank Name, Card No, IFSC code, Mobile and Email, and an invitation to receive money by inviting friends. Together, those observable features support the conclusion that the video promotes a reward or asset-acquisition offer. The record also includes an educational disclaimer, but it does not establish that payment occurred, that anyone suffered a loss, that a submission was completed, or how entered information would be used.

citations.quote: EARN DAILY FREE PAYTM CASH WITHOUT INVESTMENT
